record.question: The bullet struck a wall and was diverted from the course.
record.explanation: Answer B: deflected. A bullet deflected from its course is turned aside; “deflected” is closest (B). Independent check: To deflect a bullet is to cause it to change direction after impact; “reflected” is not the precise general equivalent. Reference: https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/deflect; https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/deflect. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Exact printed question, choices and required directions/emphasis reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
